title: CFD methods and algorithms review scorecard

points.title: Governing equations and nondimensionalization
points.notes: numerics.hpp implements compressible conservative inviscid and Newtonian-Fourier flux; solver.cpp:330–336 uses pressure gradient for temperature, compromising heat-flux discretization.

points.title: Mesh import and unstructured geometry
points.notes: main.cpp:110–130 reads CGNS/partitions on root and scatters local mesh; full mesh retained only on root for output, not replicated to all ranks during solve.

points.title: Conservative finite-volume residual
points.notes: solver.cpp:286–350 reconstructs face states, evaluates Rusanov and opposing owner/neighbor fluxes; pressure-gradient-as-temperature defect affects viscous flux.

points.title: Approximate Riemann flux and entropy fix
points.notes: solver.cpp:306 and numerics.hpp implement Rusanov flux; report identifies this dissipative choice and notes shock limitations.

points.title: Boundary conditions
points.notes: solver.cpp:799–819 outputs zero no-slip boundary velocities; Re20 selected surface has 100 rows all u=v=0. Heat gradient and surface Cf direction defects documented separately.

points.title: Second-order reconstruction
points.notes: solver.cpp:172–204 computes and exchanges Green–Gauss gradients; :286–306 reconstructs primitive face values with positivity fallback.

points.title: Limiter and positivity control
points.notes: solver.cpp:207 onward applies Barth for steady viscous and Venkatakrishnan for inviscid/transient; :1014–1019 refreshes transient limiter once per physical step, not each inner iteration.

points.title: Viscous discretization
points.notes: solver.cpp:190–204 stores rho/u/v/p gradients; :330–336 uses pressure gradient as temperature for heat flux. :782–794 uses full traction for force split. No-slip row sets u=v=0 :808–811, then Cf :820–826 falls back to x direction rather than wall tangent.

points.title: Implicit steady march
points.notes: All selected steady metadata records inner_target_converged_fraction=0; outer residual/plateau statuses must be independently checked, and M2 laminar Cd is still falling at stop.

points.title: Transient BDF2 two-loop method (Re 200)
points.notes: solver.cpp:1014–1021 recomputes gradients each inner sweep but freezes limiter after first; measured target is lagged-limiter residual, and fully refreshed strict miss count is unknown. Raw lift FFT yields St0.14 across t>=100/150/200.

points.title: MPI partitioning and scalability
points.notes: METIS and local halo implemented; M015 inviscid np4/8 last-200 mean Cd 0.002290526/0.002290542, Cl0.000415197/0.000411708. Re200 rank study is transient, no extra steady cylinder comparison.

disqualification_flags.flag: Solver uses explicit time stepping only
Report claims second-order reconstruction or limiter that is disabled in production
metadata.json claims METIS/ParMETIS but code uses geometric split or full-state replication
Re 200 run reaches final time but misses inner target on most steps (failed transient solve presented as periodic)
Normal viscous traction mislabeled as skin friction
Surface no-slip rows are actually adjacent cell-center velocities without documentation
